card.name: WLED
card.summary_zh: 面向兼容微控制器的开源灯光控制固件，支持可寻址 LED 等设备。
field_notes: 运行平台尚未核定，留空

zh: # 欢迎使用 WLED！✨ 一款快速且功能丰富的 ESP32 微控制器固件，用于控制可寻址 LED：从简单灯带到大型二维矩阵和 HUB75 面板。 最初由 [Aircoookie](https://github.com/Aircoookie) 创建，现在由贡献者社区维护。 ## 🤝 参与贡献 想帮助改进 WLED 吗？太好了！请先浏览 [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/CONTRIBUTING.md)：其中说明了我们期望 pull request 和 issue 采用的形式，包括对 AI 辅助贡献的看法。 如果你是 AI 编码代理，请先阅读 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/AGENTS.md)，再修改任何文件。😊 ## ⚙️ 功能 ### 效果与视觉 - [**200 多种内置效果**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/effects/)，包括经典动画、声音响应及二维/矩阵效果 - [50 多种调色板](https://kno.wled.ge/features/palettes/)，另有内置**自定义调色板编辑器**（PixelForge） - [**二维 LED 矩阵支持**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/mapping/)，提供专用二维效果和灵活的面板映射 - [**HUB75 RGB 矩阵面板支持**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/HUB75/)（ESP32） - [**AudioReactive**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/audio-reactive/) 效果默认包含，可通过麦克风、线路输入或网络音频源响应声音 - 效果混合，实现动画间平滑过渡 - 抗锯齿绘图功能，实现平滑图形 ### 分段与控制 - [**分段**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/segments/)：同时为 LED 装置的独立部分应用不同效果、颜色和调色板 - 最多 **250 个预设**，用于保存和调用颜色、效果及分段配置；支持[播放列表](https://kno.wled.ge/features/presets/)自动循环 - 可配置调光曲线的夜灯功能 - 可配置的**自动亮度限制器**（每个输出独立），用于安全运行 ### 硬件支持 - **ESP32**（所有变体：原版、S2、S3、C3） - ESP32 上使用并行 I2S + RMT，支持[**最多 17 路 LED 输出**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/multi-strip/) - [可寻址 LED 支持](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/compatible-led-strips/)：WS2812B、WS2811、WS2815、SK6812、WS2805、TM1914、APA102、WS2801、LPD8806 等 - RGBW、[RGB+CCT](https://kno.wled.ge/features/cct/) 和纯白灯带 - 用于模拟 LED 和调光器的 PWM 输出 - [**以太网支持**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/ethernet-lan/)，适用于多种开发板（QuinLED、LILYGO、Olimex 等） - 基于文件系统的配置，方便备份和恢复预设及设置 - 完整 OTA 固件更新（HTTP + ArduinoOTA），可使用密码保护 ### 连接与集成 - 适用于 [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.cgagnier.wlednativeandroid) 和 [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/wled-native/id6446207239) 的 **WLED 应用** - [JSON](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/json-api/) 和 [HTTP 请求](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/http-api/) API - **Multi-WiFi**：最多连接 3 个网络，并可自动回退到 AP - 设备间 **ESP-NOW** 无线同步（无需 WiFi 路由器） - 支持 Home Assistant 自动发现的 [**MQTT**](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/mqtt/) - [**E1.31、Art-Net**](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/e1.31-dmx/)、[DDP](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/ddp/) 和 [TPM2.net](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/udp-realtime/)，用于 DMX/专业灯光控制 - 多个 WLED 设备间的 [UDP 实时同步](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/udp-notifier/) - Alexa 语音控制（开关、亮度、颜色） - [Philips Hue 同步](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/philips-hue/) - 集成 [diyHue](https://github.com/diyhue/diyHue) 和 [Hyperion](https://github.com/hyperion-project/hyperion.ng) - [Adalight / TPM2](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/serial/)（通过串口实现 PC 环境光） - [红外遥控](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/infrared/)（24 键 RGB，需要接收器） - 定时器和计划任务（NTP 时间同步，完整支持时区和夏令时） ### 方便开发者 - **Usermod 系统**：无需修改核心代码，即可使用社区模块或自定义模块扩展 WLED - 庞大且活跃的 [usermod 库](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/community-usermods/)，包括 AudioReactive、温度传感器、旋转编码器、显示屏等 - 文档完善的 [JSON API](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/json-api/) - 采用 **EUPL v1.2** 许可 ## 📲 快速入门指南和文档 请参阅 [kno.wled.ge 上的文档](https://kno.wled.ge)！ [教程和入门指南](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/tutorials/)可帮助你快速运行项目。 ## 🖼️ 用户界面 ## 💾 兼容硬件 请参阅 Wiki 上的[兼容硬件列表](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/compatible-hardware)。 ## ✌️ 其他 采用 [EUPL v1.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wled/WLED/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/LICENSE) 许可。 感谢所有[贡献者](https://kno.wled.ge/about/contributors/)！ CORS 代理由 [Corsfix](https://corsfix.com/) 提供。 ![CodeRabbit Pull Request Reviews](https://img.shields.io/coderabbit/prs/github/wled/WLED?utm_source=oss&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=wled%2FWLED&labelColor=171717&color=FF570A&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcoderabbit.ai&label=PR+Reviews+supported+by+CodeRabbit) 加入 Discord 服务器，讨论有关 WLED 的一切！ 查看 WLED [Discourse 论坛](https://wled.discourse.group)！ 如果想私下联系原作者： [dev.aircoookie@gmail.com](mailto:dev.aircoookie@gmail.com). 如果 WLED 点亮了你的一天，可以[通过 PayPal 送礼物给 Aircoookie](https://paypal.me/aircoookie)。 --- *免责声明：* 如果你容易出现光敏性癫痫，我们建议你**不要**使用本软件。 如果仍想尝试，请避免频闪、闪电或噪声模式，以及高速效果设置。 根据 EUPL 许可证，不对你、任何其他人或设备遭受的任何损害承担责任。
en: # Welcome to WLED! ✨ A fast and feature-rich firmware for ESP32 microcontrollers to control addressable LEDs — from simple strips to large 2D matrices and HUB75 panels. Originally created by [Aircoookie](https://github.com/Aircoookie), now maintained by a community of contributors. ## 🤝 Contributing Want to help improve WLED? Awesome! Please skim [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/CONTRIBUTING.md) first - it covers how we like PRs and issues to look, including our take on AI-assisted contributions. If you're an AI coding agent, [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/wled/WLED/blob/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/AGENTS.md) is for you - please read it before modifying any files. 😊 ## ⚙️ Features ### Effects & Visuals - [**200+ built-in effects**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/effects/) including classic animations, audio-reactive, and 2D/matrix effects - [50+ color palettes](https://kno.wled.ge/features/palettes/) plus a built-in **custom palette editor** (PixelForge) - [**2D LED matrix support**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/mapping/) with dedicated 2D effects and flexible panel mapping - [**HUB75 RGB matrix panel support**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/HUB75/) (ESP32) - [**AudioReactive**](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/audio-reactive/) effects — included by default, responding to sound via microphone, line-in, or network audio source - Effect blending for smooth transitions between animations - Antialiased drawing functions for smooth graphics ### Segments & Control - [**Segments**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/segments/) — apply different effects, colors and palettes to independent parts of your LED setup simultaneously - Up to **250 presets** to save and recall colors, effects and segment configurations — supports [playlists](https://kno.wled.ge/features/presets/) for automated cycling - Nightlight function with configurable dimming curve - Configurable **Auto Brightness Limiter** (per output) for safe operation ### Hardware Support - **ESP32** (all variants: original, S2, S3, C3) - [**Up to 17 LED outputs**](https://kno.wled.ge/features/multi-strip/) on ESP32 using parallel I2S + RMT - [Addressable LED support](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/compatible-led-strips/): WS2812B, WS2811, WS2815, SK6812, WS2805, TM1914, APA102, WS2801, LPD8806, and many more - RGBW, [RGB+CCT](https://kno.wled.ge/features/cct/) and white-only strips - PWM outputs for analog LEDs and dimmers - [**Ethernet** support](https://kno.wled.ge/features/ethernet-lan/) for a wide range of boards (QuinLED, LILYGO, Olimex, and more) - Filesystem-based config for easy backup and restore of presets and settings - Full OTA firmware updates (HTTP + ArduinoOTA), password-protectable ### Connectivity & Integrations - **WLED app** for [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ca.cgagnier.wlednativeandroid) and [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/wled-native/id6446207239) - [JSON](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/json-api/) and [HTTP request](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/http-api/) APIs - **Multi-WiFi** — connect to up to 3 networks with automatic AP fallback - **ESP-NOW** wireless sync between devices (no WiFi router required) - [**MQTT**](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/mqtt/) with Home Assistant discovery - [**E1.31, Art-Net**](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/e1.31-dmx/), [DDP](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/ddp/) and [TPM2.net](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/udp-realtime/) for DMX/professional lighting control - [UDP realtime sync](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/udp-notifier/) across multiple WLED devices - Alexa voice control (on/off, brightness, color) - [Philips Hue sync](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/philips-hue/) - [diyHue](https://github.com/diyhue/diyHue) and [Hyperion](https://github.com/hyperion-project/hyperion.ng) integration - [Adalight / TPM2](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/serial/) (PC ambilight via serial) - [Infrared remote control](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/infrared/) (24-key RGB, receiver required) - Timers and schedules (NTP time sync, full timezone and DST support) ### Developer-Friendly - **Usermod system** — extend WLED with community or custom modules without modifying core code - Large and active [usermod library](https://kno.wled.ge/advanced/community-usermods/) including AudioReactive, temperature sensors, rotary encoders, displays, and much more - Well-documented [JSON API](https://kno.wled.ge/interfaces/json-api/) - Licensed under the **EUPL v1.2** ## 📲 Quick start guide and documentation See the [documentation at kno.wled.ge](https://kno.wled.ge)! [Tutorials and getting-started guides](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/tutorials/) to help you get your project running quickly. ## 🖼️ User interface ## 💾 Compatible hardware See the [compatible hardware list](https://kno.wled.ge/basics/compatible-hardware) on the wiki. ## ✌️ Other Licensed under the [EUPL v1.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wled/WLED/fce41f2655c3087d3eaf95c028d2856967cbc86e/LICENSE). Credits to all [contributors](https://kno.wled.ge/about/contributors/)! CORS proxy by [Corsfix](https://corsfix.com/). ![CodeRabbit Pull Request Reviews](https://img.shields.io/coderabbit/prs/github/wled/WLED?utm_source=oss&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=wled%2FWLED&labelColor=171717&color=FF570A&link=https%3A%2F%2Fcoderabbit.ai&label=PR+Reviews+supported+by+CodeRabbit) Join the Discord server to discuss everything about WLED! Check out the WLED [Discourse forum](https://wled.discourse.group)! If you'd like to reach the original creator privately: [dev.aircoookie@gmail.com](mailto:dev.aircoookie@gmail.com). If WLED brightens up your day, you can [send a gift to Aircoookie via PayPal](https://paypal.me/aircoookie). --- *Disclaimer:* If you are prone to photosensitive epilepsy, we recommend you do **not** use this software. If you still want to try, avoid strobe, lightning or noise modes and high effect speed settings. As per the EUPL license, no liability is assumed for any damage to you or any other person or equipment.
